name: Connect Four (native)
description: Classic Connect Four on a 6-row, 7-column board, played natively by the board mechanism.

brief.situation: Two players face each other across an upright Connect Four board with 6 rows and 7 columns.
brief.rules: Red (X) moves first. On your turn drop a piece into a column that is not full; it falls to the lowest empty cell, which is how the move is written (d1 is the bottom of column d). The first player with four pieces in a row horizontally, vertically or diagonally wins at once. A full board with no four in a row is a draw.

roles.player: Connect four of your own pieces before your opponent does, and block their lines of three.
